Insight: PPF has the strongest overall investment preference with an average preference rank of 2.02. Lower rank indicates stronger preference.
Capital Appreciation is the most common investment objective among the surveyed investors.
Financial Consultants is the most frequently reported information source among survey respondents.
Wealth Creation is the most common reported investment purpose.
Returns is the leading reported decision factor influencing investment choices.
3-5 years is the most common investment duration reported by respondents.
20%-30% is the most common expected-return range reported by respondents.
Among female respondents, PPF has the strongest preference based on the lowest average preference rank of 2.33.
Among investors under 30, PPF has the strongest preference based on average preference rank.
